content: 1-minute counter-trend search is running. Pre-registered (research/mass_1m/PROTOCOL.md): 6 fade families (VWAP snap-back, volume exhaustion, opening-range fade, RSI extreme, Keltner fade, stretch fade) on 1-, 3- and 5-minute bars, long/short symmetric, 5 session windows, 72 exit combos — 198,720 configs on the same engine, costs, early-close fix and $2k rules; trained on ES/NQ 2010-18 + MES/MNQ 2019-23 (14 years), same per-year gates + placebo + deflated Sharpe, frozen list validated once on MES/MNQ 2024-25, 2026 never loaded. Smoke test confirms the mechanics (a 1-min VWAP rule fires ~4,500 times in 14 years, so cost drag is what it has to beat). ETA ~4-5 h for training; report then.
